h1: Custom Jersey Jackets for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom jersey jackets in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for teams, events, and corporate gifts. Soft, breathable fabric.
introHtml: Jersey jackets offer a soft, breathable alternative to traditional fleece or woven shells, making them ideal for mild-weather events, trade shows, and team outings. The double-knit construction provides a smooth surface for full-color screen printing or embroidery, so your logo stands out clearly. Whether you're outfitting a sales team for a spring campaign or creating staff uniforms for a community run, custom jersey jackets deliver comfort and a polished look without the bulk of heavier outerwear.
heroAltText: Custom jersey jackets in navy blue with embroidered logo, featuring a half-zip front and stand-up collar.
